children: Westinghouse Electric is seeking a valuation of more than $50B in its U.S. initial public offering, which it is targeting for as soon as October, although details of the offering including the timing could still change, Bloomberg reported Friday.
Citigroup and Goldman Sachs are leading the IPO, with CIBC, J.P. Morgan Chase, Royal Bank of Canada also working on the listing, according to the report.
Westinghouse is jointly owned by Brookfield Renewable Partners
, which completed a deal in 2023 to buy a 49% stake in the company at a ~$8B value.

Westinghouse looks set to benefit from the Trump administration's efforts to boost the U.S. nuclear industry, and the U.S. Army recently selected it as one of five firms to build, own, and operate its power plants.
The company's nuclear power technology is used by 57% of the world's nuclear reactors and boasts a pipeline of as many as 91 opportunities for its latest generation reactor.
